description: This Java class implements a health checker for MQTT transport in the Thingsboard monitoring system. It manages MQTT client initialization, sending test payloads, and cleanup.

classes.name: MqttTransportHealthChecker
classes.description: A class that checks the health of MQTT transport by managing MQTT client connection, sending test messages, and disconnecting.

methods.name: initClient
methods.description: Initializes the MQTT client if not already connected, setting up connection options and establishing connection.

methods.name: sendTestPayload
methods.description: Sends a test payload message to the MQTT telemetry topic.

methods.name: destroyClient
methods.description: Disconnects and cleans up the MQTT client.

methods.name: getTransportType
methods.description: Returns the transport type, which is MQTT.
